title: heterogeneous literals compile under every declared any boundary
purpose: A typed binding, an @any parameter, an action result, nested @@any and %string:@any positions and %string:any map values each box a heterogeneous literal; homogeneous literals and an untagged [] beside [1] (#297) keep exact types.

provenance.expected_basis: Owner decision on #315: heterogeneous concrete elements without an expected any element type are a compile-time error; any is never inferred.
